hints.title: Regular Expression Matching
hints.text: Use a regular expression to validate the format of email addresses.

hints.title: Local Part Constraints
hints.text: Ensure the local part contains alphanumeric characters and underscores only.

hints.title: Domain and Extension Constraints
hints.text: Verify the domain consists of letters followed by the com extension.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT user_id, email
FROM Users
WHERE email REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+@[A-Za-z]+\\.com$'
ORDER BY user_id;
```

variables: n: number of rows in Users table
complexity.notes: Performs regex pattern match on each row and orders resulting records by user_id.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Substring slicing and manual parsing are prone to edge-case errors compared to anchored regex.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Filtering occurs during table scan with standard sorting buffer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Writes anchored regex correctly matching local part and domain constraints.

solutions.code:
SELECT user_id, email
FROM Users
WHERE email REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+@[A-Za-z]+\\.com$'
ORDER BY user_id;

SELECT user_id, email
FROM Users
WHERE email ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+@[A-Za-z]+\x2Ecom$'
ORDER BY user_id;
